Axiom: Explicit complete contracts; protected domain and contract representations
Reason: These published facts are durable JSON wire contracts. Their field names must survive Go identifier changes and replay of persisted events.
Alternatives: Keep a second set of private serialization structs in every producer and consumer. This duplicates the compatibility contract and permits their representations to drift.
Containment: Only JSON tags are permitted by this exception. Database tags, SQLC types, database dependencies and transport handlers remain prohibited. Facts contain values and identifiers, never consumer cache instructions.
ExitPlan: Review these wire contracts before introducing the next event version; migrate persisted event payloads or keep an explicit version decoder before removing JSON field names.
